name: Possessed Daeodons OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #5-15: Cleansing the Flame

stealth.note: or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Detect Magic] to notice the heavy divine magic in the area

description: Three daeodon corpses, animated and enraged by Sezelrian's divine intervention, trample anything within the ritual circle.
disable: DC 21 Occultism or DC 21 Religion to disrupt the magic animating the spirits, DC 25 Athletics to hold down one of the daeodons, or Dispel Magic (3rd-rank, counteract DC 25). 3 successes are required.
reset: The hazard resets within 24 hours if the cultists of Sezelrian still remain in the area.
routine: (three actions) The animated daeodons trample all creatures within the circle, dealing (2d8+9) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 23 Reflex Saving Throw save).

offensiveAbilities.name: Fires of Sabotage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature enters the area of the ritual circle

Effect The outline of the circle alights with fire dealing 4d6 Fire Damage damage to all creatures within it (Basic DC 24 Reflex Saving Throw save). The trap then rolls initiative.
